description: This file contains functions for generating a Profit and Loss Statement report in an ERP system, including data retrieval, calculation of net profit/loss, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the profit and loss report data, including columns, data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Calculates and returns a summary of income, expense, and net profit for the report.

methods.name: get_net_profit_loss
methods.description: Computes net profit or loss over the period list, returning a structured dictionary.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data (labels and datasets) for visualization of income, expense, and net profit/loss.
